name: downloads-lookup
description: When a prompt mentions the Downloads folder, finds the files and folders there whose names match the prompt and hands Claude their paths, so it does not have to search.

folder.title: Downloads folder
folder.description: Absolute path of your Downloads folder, if it is not ~/Downloads. A leading ~ means your home folder.

triggerWords.title: Extra trigger words
triggerWords.description: Comma-separated words, in any language, that make a prompt count as mentioning Downloads (added to "downloads"). Example: descargas.
